title: History of the CPSU — Short Course
author: Iósif Stalin (ed.)
desc: Historia oficial del Partido Comunista soviético.
tesis: Historia oficial del Partido Comunista de la Unión Soviética editada bajo la dirección de Stalin. Narra la historia del partido desde sus orígenes hasta la consolidación del poder soviético, presentando la línea bolchevique como siempre correcta y a los opositores como siempre equivocados. Fue el texto obligatorio de formación política para millones de comunistas en todo el mundo.
ideas: La historia del PCUS según esta versión es la historia de la línea correcta (bolchevique/estalinista) contra las desviaciones.
Fue el libro de texto obligatorio del movimiento comunista internacional durante décadas.
Contiene el capítulo sobre materialismo dialéctico e histórico que se convirtió en la versión canónica de la filosofía marxista.
contexto: Publicada en 1938 bajo la dirección de Stalin, fue el texto obligatorio de formación comunista en todo el mundo. Tras el XX Congreso (1956) fue criticada por distorsiones históricas. Sigue siendo documento indispensable para entender la autorepresentación del poder soviético.

conexiones.razon: Fundamentos y la Historia del PCUS son los dos textos canónicos del marxismo-leninismo estalinista.
Losurdo contextualiza la época en que esta historia oficial fue escrita y por qué.

quotes.text: «Maquiavelo es el teórico de las condiciones políticas de la constitución en las condiciones extraordinarias que son las de la carencia de cualquier forma política en grado de producir ese resultado».

tl: Plejánov funda el Grupo Emancipación del Trabajo en Ginebra

The first Russian Marxist group arose in 1883. This was the "Emancipation of Labour" group formed by G. V. Plekhanov abroad, in Geneva, where he had been obliged to take refuge from the persecution of the tsarist government.
Primer Congreso del POSDR en Minsk funda el partido
In 1898 several of the Leagues of Struggle... summoned the First Congress of the Russian Social-Democratic Labour Party (R.S.D.L.P.), which was held in Minsk in March 1898.
Bolshevism is born at the RSDLP Second Congress

The Second Congress of the R.S.D.L.P. opened on July 17 (30, new style), 1903. It first met in Brussels, but the Belgian police requested the delegates to leave the country. Thereupon the congress transferred its sittings to London.
Domingo Sangriento en San Petersburgo

Early in the morning of January 9, 1905, the workers marched to the Winter Palace where the tsar was then residing. They came with their whole families... They were unarmed. Over 140,000 persons gathered in the streets.
Conferencia de Praga elige a Stalin al Comité Central
By expelling the Mensheviks from the Party, the Prague Conference formally inaugurated the independent existence of the Bolshevik Party.
La Revolución Rusa abre la crisis del imperialismo

On February 18, 1917, a strike broke out at the Putilov Works in Petrograd. On International Women's Day, February 23 (March 8), at the call of the Petrograd Bolshevik Committee, working women came out in the streets to demonstrate against starvation
Revolución de Octubre

The cruiser Aurora trained its guns on the Winter Palace, and on October 25 their thunder ushered in a new era, the era of the Great Socialist Revolution... announcing that the bourgeois Provisional Government had been deposed
Comienza la Guerra Civil e intervención extranjera

This was the end of the respite in Russia and the beginning of the Civil War, which was a war of the workers and peasants of the nations of Russia against the foreign and domestic enemies of the Soviet power.
Tratado de Brest-Litovsk

The negotiations began on December 3 in Brest-Litovsk. On December 5 an armistice was signed. The negotiations took place at a time when the country was in a state of economic disruption, when war-weariness was universal.
Tenth Congress adopts NEP — retreat to prepare offensive

The Central Committee realized that the need for the surplus-appropriation system had passed, that it was time to supersede it by a tax in kind so as to enable the peasants to use the greater part of their surpluses at their own discretion.
Enero 1924: muerte de Lenin

On January 21, 1924, Lenin, our leader and teacher, the creator of the Bolshevik Party, passed away in the village of Gorki, near Moscow. Lenin's death was received by the working class of the whole world as a most cruel loss.
Decimosexta Conferencia adopta el Primer Plan Quinquenal

In April 1929, the Party held its Sixteenth Conference, with the First Five-Year Plan as the main item on the agenda. The conference rejected the "minimal" variant... and adopted the "optimal" variant as binding.
Comienza el movimiento masivo de colectivización

On this basis began the mass collective-farm movement, which later developed rapidly, especially towards the end of 1929, progressing at an unprecedented rate, a rate unknown even to our Socialist industry.
Asesinato de Sandino
On December 1, 1934, S. M. Kirov was foully murdered in the Smolny, in Leningrad, by a shot from a revolver.
Primer Proceso de Moscú contra Zinóviev y Kámenev

Confronted by direct evidence, they had to admit publicly, in open court, that they had not only organized the assassination of Kirov, but had been planning to murder all the other leaders of the Party and the Government.
Procesos contra el bloque trotskista-bujarinista

In 1937, new facts came to light regarding the fiendish crimes of the Bukharin-Trotsky gang. The trial of Pyatakov, Radek and others, the trial of Tukhachevsky, Yakir and others, and the trial of Bukharin, Rykov, Krestinsky, Rosengoltz and others
